label.administrable_evidence: Eligible applicants under the Bollards Competitive Grant Program are State Departments of Transportation (State DOTs) and local government entities such as any city, county, town, parish, village, or other general-purpose political subdivision of a State).

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The grant focuses on infrastructure and safety measures for pedestrians, which does not directly align with any of the DHHS strategic plan objectives.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The grant focuses on pedestrian safety and infrastructure, which does not directly align with any of the DMVA strategic plan objectives.
